What is the V1 overworld target size (km / play minutes edge-to-edge) beyond the V0 world (2800 × 2800 m / 64 m chunks already locked in 17)? The same entry notes a measured budget: about 2.5–3 km² of dry land fits two large cities; three with real travel between them needs 4–6 km². That means growing the world, not just the island.
When does Piece-Based Assembly fully replace the single hand-placed Interior V0 template scene as authority for Interior Scenes? The mechanism itself is locked; only the V0 to V1 timing is open.
When does additive interior/arena load replace the V0 single-scene swap? The V0 default is locked in 17; the V1 timing is open.

99 holds Stage 3F valley-carve questions 3F-1 through 3F-25. They are research and production-terrain questions. They are not current gameplay-design blockers. Production terrain stays unchanged, Stage 3F stays experimental, and an agent recommendation in that section is not a decision.

How many rituals must the cult complete before the capital? Resolved: no fixed count. The Capital Gate opens when every other city is under Cult Control. Scheduling and concurrency moved to CC-4; difficulty ownership to CC-14.

Which public events enter the daily bulletin and map, how quickly do reports spread, and when does a source reveal an exact ritual site versus only a region? The private daily summary always records the player's own actions; its interface and retention remain open.
Which cult command roles must be removed to complete the campaign before manifestation? Resolved: killing all three Cult Generals is the only way.
Where is the final awakening ritual held? It is fixed at the centre of the capital.
How much can other autonomous practitioners change ritual outcomes? What state triggers the separate planet-destruction rite? Off-screen clashes are tracked as CC-15, allied behaviour as CC-16.
Which actions and scoring weights determine the final campaign rating?
Beyond killing or capturing all responsible ritualists, which non-combat methods can stop a ritual, and what custody, escape, and return-to-cult rules support taking them alive?
After the ending rating, can the surviving character continue in an epilogue or free-play state, and how does that relate to the world's finite life-cycle?
CC-1. The length is decided: 15–20 game days at the middle difficulty. Is the pace even or accelerating, and how many quiet days come before the first city falls?
sectionTitle: High Priority — Cult Campaign and City Control

text: CC-2. The target is decided: 3×3 tiles and 5–7 cities, ideally 7. Does the count include the capital, what is the minimum distance between cities, and what terrain plan delivers this?
sectionTitle: High Priority — Cult Campaign and City Control

text: CC-3. Which actors must leave a city for the cult's clearing to complete: hidden allied followers, Minor Faction members, unaffiliated practitioners, the player character? Can a lone player keep a city from falling just by being there?
sectionTitle: High Priority — Cult Campaign and City Control

text: CC-4. Resolved: attack, clearing, a six-hour ritual that can still be stopped, then a garrison stays. Garrison numbers belong with CC-12.
CC-5. Resolved: a capture ritual makes a city a Place of Power and keeps residents alive as sacrifices. Remaining questions moved to CC-20 and CC-21.

CC-6. The closed-zone rule, stealth, and the dialogue check are decided. How does being noticed work, what does the check consist of, do prices or stock change, and which Symptoms show a captured city?
sectionTitle: High Priority — Cult Campaign and City Control
